statement: The attempt auto-capture in scripts/solve/step.js no longer sweeps another Quest's regenerated solve/evidence receipts into this Quest's recorded change: evidence whose owner quest id is read from its path (solve/evidence/<id>.receipt.json or solve/evidence/<id>/) and differs from the capturing Quest is excluded, evidence of uncertain ownership and the Quest's own evidence stay captured exactly as before, and a product Quest is no longer refused with "workflow changes must be recorded in a workflow Quest" because a foreign receipt was dirty; scripts/quest-evidence-harness-runtime.js gains --output <path> so a receipt can be regenerated to a scratch path without dirtying solve/evidence (default output and receipt bytes unchanged, generatedAt kept in evidence identity). Proven deterministically on the real capture path: red on HEAD, green after.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The Solver landing/attempt owner under scripts/solve remains the single authority; no duplicated predicate is introduced elsewhere.

Auto-capture excludes evidence owned by another quest id only when ownership is read from the path (solve/evidence/<id>.receipt.json or solve/evidence/<id>/); uncertain ownership stays inside the sealed artifact and the quest's own evidence is captured exactly as before.
Evidence identity keeps generatedAt; the harness runtime's default output path and receipt bytes are unchanged, and --output fails closed on a missing value.
Proof is a deterministic replay of the recorded operator sequence through the real Solver modules on a temporary repository fixture, red on HEAD and green after, with controls that must stay green.
